Job Description
WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON​
What you will focus on
Design and ensure minor game features are implemented well. Maintain and improve existing features in game based on data and feedback.
What it means on a daily basis​

• Design and improve small features under guidance from a senior/lead Game Designer; write and maintain game design documents (GDDs) in Confluence.
• Implement and present new features.
• Tweak feature parameters and fix design bugs using the project's toolsets and JIRA.
• Review game builds and adjust features during implementation.
• Track localization for new in-game text.
• Join brainstorming and check-in meetings; stay current on toolsets, market trends, and platform knowledge.
What success will look like

• Deliver GDDs on time, with visual aids, aligned to game direction.
• Resolve design bugs and deliver features on schedule, with text localized before release.
• Contribute actively in brainstorming sessions, keep GDDs current, and clear all assigned JIRA bugs.
• Complete learning that supports current responsibilities
​Who you would be working with

• Reports to the Studio Game Design Lead/Project Lead Game Designer and relevant producers.
• Works daily with Game Designers, Artists, and Programmers to implement and tune features.
• Collaborates with Game Economy Design (GED) on systems, difficulty, and learning curve.
• Collaborates with UI/UX Game Designers to improve UX and flow.
Where can this role take you?

• Entry point into the Game Design career path, progressing to Junior 2, Senior, and Lead as scope grows.
• Advance into focused roles such as UI/UX Game Designer, Technical Game Designer.
Recruitment Journey
Only candidates whose qualifications align with the role will be contacted. We sincerely appreciate your understanding.

• (1) Screening call with HR (30 mins)
• (2) Test
• (3) Interview with Studio Game Designer Lead, (Senior Game Designer)

Qualifications
WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED​

• Basic understanding of game mechanics, level design, and UI/UX for mobile games.
• Basic game balancing skills.
• Able to write clear GDDs and wireframes.
• Basic scripting literacy is a plus.
• Familiarity with tools like Unity, Unreal, Figma, Confluence, and JIRA is a plus.
WHO YOU ARE

• Creative thinker with strong storytelling skills.
• Open-minded, fast learner, open to feedback.
• Strong teamwork and communication skills.
• Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
• Fluent in English.

Additional Information
WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU
Benefits

• A hybrid working model (5 working days per week – max 3 days WFH) ​
• A range of well-being events and policies to support employees (leave scheme, medical check-up, wellness gift, wedding/condolences, etc.)
• An attractive salary package with the full salary for the probation period​
• Monthly lunch allowance and home office support​
• Yearly salary review & bonuses​
• Minimum 12 days of paid annual leave, plus 5 days of paid sick leave, Christmas leave, Birthday leave, ...
• 100% coverage of mandatory insurance and extra healthcare insurance. ​
• Various training packages, including internal training, sponsorship training, and e-learning (iLearn, Udemy, O’Reilly, ...). ​
• Opportunities to collaborate and train with Gameloft worldwide experts and develop yourselves. ​
• Relocation support for international candidates joining from overseas.
• Other benefits from one of the best employers in Vietnam.
Life at Gameloft

• A multicultural environment with 6+ nationalities, where hundreds of world-renowned game titles were born.​
• An open-space office, a cafeteria, a ping-pong table, and a foosball table.
• A gaming area equipped with multiple devices (PS, Nintendo Switch, ...)
• A wide range of internal events and sports clubs to boost connection and work-life balance.
Work Location: 3&4 Floor, Lilama 10 Building, 56 To Huu, Dai Mo Ward, Ha Noi, Vietnam.
